claim_verdicts.claim_text: The record supports spironolactone as the explanation for the onset of this patient's elevated potassium.
claim_verdicts.why: Potassium was already 5.7 mmol/L on 2026-03-02, before spironolactone's first dose on 2026-03-03, so spironolactone cannot explain the initial onset; the timeline contradicts this causal claim.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: Spironolactone is the explanation for the onset of elevated potassium, as documented by the treating physician.
